capabilities: Browse categorized LaTeX symbols (Greek, operators, arrows)
Search symbols by their LaTeX code
Insert symbols into the active note with cursor refocus
Edit the symbol library as JSON in settings
Toggle the panel between sidebar and floating pop-out window
extras: README is fully duplicated in Chinese; interface language auto-switches between English and Chinese based on Obsidian's language setting.
problem: Writing math in Obsidian requires memorizing or looking up LaTeX codes for symbols, and there is no built-in symbol picker.
summary: Symbol panel that categorizes LaTeX symbols, searches them by code, and inserts them into the active note from a sidebar or pop-out window.
